parsed.notes:
Prior AI experience is explicitly required; subsequent curiosity and enthusiasm do not soften that requirement.
Model training and production operation are explicitly optional and repeated under Nice to have.
Flagged whether ML in 'training ML models' additionally names machine-learning beyond the specific training practice.
Read 'working as an engineer' literally: it does not explicitly specify software engineering, so retained it as unmapped rather than assuming that specialization.
Leadership, communication, technical judgment, and adaptability are excluded as soft skills. Technologies and infrastructure mentioned only in the title, company description, or responsibilities are excluded.
No alternative skill groups, German requirement, or degree requirement are stated.
